name: northwind-sample-v1
description: Labelled QA set over the 7-document Northwind sample corpus (PDF, DOCX, TXT). 'evidence' phrases are copied verbatim from the sources; a retrieved chunk is relevant when it contains >= 80% of an evidence phrase's content terms. Categories: direct (wording overlaps the source), paraphrase (vocabulary mismatch), distractor (a similar but wrong document exists), multi (answer needs two facts), unanswerable (not in the corpus).

items.question: How many days of paid annual leave do employees with two to five years of service receive?
items.expected_answer: 22 days of paid annual leave per year
evidence: Employees with two to five years of service receive 22 days of paid annual leave per year

items.question: I've been at the company for three years. How much vacation time do I get?
items.expected_answer: 22 days
evidence: Employees with two to five years of service receive 22 days of paid annual leave per year

items.question: How many unused annual leave days can be carried over and when do they expire?
items.expected_answer: Up to 5 days, used by March 31
evidence: Up to 5 unused annual leave days may be carried over into the next calendar year
Carried-over days must be used by March 31 of the following year

items.question: When do I need a doctor's note for being off sick?
items.expected_answer: medical certificate required for absences longer than three consecutive working days
evidence: A medical certificate is required for absences longer than three consecutive working days

items.question: How many weeks of parental leave does the primary caregiver get?
items.expected_answer: 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave
evidence: The primary caregiver is entitled to 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave

items.question: How far in advance must annual leave be requested?
items.expected_answer: at least ten working days in advance through the HR portal
evidence: Annual leave must be requested through the HR portal at least ten working days in advance

items.question: How much time off is given when a close relative dies?
items.expected_answer: up to 5 days of paid bereavement leave
evidence: up to 5 days of paid bereavement leave following the death of an immediate family member

items.question: What is the maximum unpaid leave and who must approve it?
items.expected_answer: up to 3 months with written approval of a director
evidence: Employees may request unpaid leave of up to 3 months
Unpaid leave requires the written approval of a director

items.question: Do contractors get paid annual leave?
items.expected_answer: No, contractors do not accrue paid annual leave
evidence: Contractors do not accrue paid annual leave, sick leave or parental leave

items.question: When are contractor timesheets due?
items.expected_answer: weekly by Monday at 12:00 for the previous week
evidence: Contractors must submit weekly timesheets through the vendor portal by Monday at 12:00 for the previous week

items.question: When does a contractor receive a company laptop?
items.expected_answer: only when the engagement exceeds three months
evidence: Contractors receive a Northwind laptop only when their engagement exceeds three months

items.question: What torque should the DC terminals of the SI-5000 inverter be tightened to?
items.expected_answer: 2.5 Nm
evidence: tighten all DC terminals to a torque of 2.5 Nm

items.question: Explain the safety procedure before opening the solar inverter enclosure.
items.expected_answer: switch off the AC breaker, isolate the DC disconnect, wait five minutes for capacitors to discharge, verify absence of voltage
evidence: switch off the AC breaker and then isolate the DC disconnect switch
Wait at least five minutes for the internal capacitors to discharge
Verify the absence of voltage with a calibrated multimeter

items.question: How often must the inverter air filters be cleaned?
items.expected_answer: every six months using low-pressure compressed air
evidence: The air filters must be cleaned every six months using low-pressure compressed air

items.question: What does the E-47 fault on the inverter mean?
items.expected_answer: Overtemperature: heat sink exceeded 85 degrees Celsius
evidence: E-47 Overtemperature: the heat sink exceeded 85 degrees Celsius

items.question: When should the inverter's fan be swapped out?
items.expected_answer: grinding noise, speed below 2000 rpm, or after 50000 operating hours
evidence: Replace the cooling fan if it produces grinding noise, if its speed falls below 2000 rpm, or after 50000 operating hours

items.question: What insulation resistance reading indicates a fault in the PV array?
items.expected_answer: below 1 megaohm
evidence: a reading below 1 megaohm indicates an insulation fault

items.question: How long is the SI-5000 warranty and what voids it?
items.expected_answer: 10 year warranty, void if maintenance records are not kept or enclosure opened by unqualified personnel
evidence: The SI-5000 is covered by a 10 year manufacturer warranty
The warranty is void if maintenance records are not kept

items.question: What happens if the inverter firmware update is interrupted?
items.expected_answer: requires a factory reset by the manufacturer
evidence: an interrupted update requires a factory reset by the manufacturer

items.question: How often must the battery storage fire suppression system be inspected?
items.expected_answer: every six months by an accredited contractor
evidence: The fire suppression system must be inspected and certified every six months by an accredited contractor

items.question: What should I do if a battery cabinet starts smoking?
items.expected_answer: do not open it, evacuate at least 30 metres and call emergency services
evidence: Never open a cabinet that is emitting smoke; evacuate to a distance of at least 30 metres and call the emergency services

items.question: What is the minimum password length?
items.expected_answer: at least 14 characters
evidence: Passwords must be at least 14 characters long

items.question: Is it OK to use text message codes as a second login factor?
items.expected_answer: No, SMS codes are not an approved method
evidence: SMS codes are not an approved method

items.question: How quickly must a lost laptop be reported?
items.expected_answer: within 1 hour to the service desk
evidence: Lost or stolen devices must be reported to the service desk within 1 hour

items.question: What are the four data classification levels?
items.expected_answer: Public, Internal, Confidential and Restricted
evidence: Information is classified into four levels: Public, Internal, Confidential and Restricted

items.question: Do we have to change our passwords every 90 days?
items.expected_answer: No, passwords are changed only on evidence or suspicion of compromise
evidence: Passwords are changed only when there is evidence or suspicion of compromise; routine periodic password rotation is not required

items.question: What is the hotel limit per night in major cities?
items.expected_answer: 220 US dollars
evidence: The nightly hotel limit is 220 US dollars in major cities

items.question: When can I fly business class?
items.expected_answer: flights longer than six hours with approval from a vice president
evidence: Business class is permitted for flights longer than six hours with approval from a vice president

items.question: How long do I have to file my expense report after a business trip?
items.expected_answer: within 30 days of the end of the trip
evidence: Expense claims must be submitted within 30 days of the end of the trip

items.question: How long is the probation period for new employees?
items.expected_answer: six months
evidence: All new employees complete a six month probation period

items.question: How much does the company contribute to my retirement savings?
items.expected_answer: matches employee contributions up to 6 percent of base salary
evidence: The company pension scheme matches employee contributions up to 6 percent of base salary

items.question: What is the company's policy on bringing pets to the office?
What is the replacement cost of an SI-5000 inverter?
Who is the current CEO of Northwind Energy?
